scope.target: Descriptive pooled-recorded-unit conditional category-selection sensitivity in the fixed expanded human MTL release; not a paper-number reproduction or patient-population inference.

papers.relationship: Faraut2018 uses one-way 1x5 ANOVA in a 1.5-second interval starting 0.2 seconds after onset and applies additional behavioral criteria. Its Table2 defines session-variant category dictionaries.

Chandravadia2020 describes the expanded NWB release; Fig5 visual selection uses one-way 1x5 ANOVA in a one-second interval starting 0.2 seconds after onset. The present KW/1.5-second/50-half method is an explicit adaptation.

scope.independence: Recorded units cluster within sessions and repeated patients; unit keys do not prove distinct biological neurons across sessions. Repeated halves overlap, and final >=5-selection eligibility uses all repeated training events. A test trial in one repeat may affect selection in another. No IID-unit/split CI, independent outer validation, patient-generalization, neuron-prevalence, neural-specificity or causal claim is implied.
scope.forbidden_outcome_gates: No required AUC band, above-chance result, direction, same-trial versus held-out ordering, selected fraction, biological absence or prose keywords. Both declared headline populations are valid.

source.integrity: Authenticate the frozen manifest and every original size/SHA256 in the exact closed inventory before source parsing. Regular files only; no symlink or external HDF5 data links. No runtime network, cached response array, historical bank or scientific source replacement.
source.session_key: Exact full original asset_path. Literal /general/session_id may be absent and remains null; do not synthesize it from a date.
source.unit_key: asset_path + '::unit=' + base10 original unit_id without padding
source.canonical_order: Assets sorted by Unicode full path, then original zero-based unit-table row; recognition trials in original trial-table row order. IDs are identities, not row positions.
source.text: Strict UTF-8; preserve original category names, paths, IDs, phase strings and label tokens without normalization. variant_prefix is the first original image-path component interpreted with Windows slash semantics; the original full path is separately unchanged.
source.unit_mapping: Use /units/electrodes DynamicTableRegion and electrodes_index to the original /general/extracellular_ephys/electrodes table ROW. Require exactly one valid link per unit; preserve electrode row/ID/origChannel/location. Include iff location contains case-sensitive Hippocampus or Amygdala; both is ambiguous and fails. This is not a peak-channel measurement. No firing, waveform, behavior, isolation or confidence exclusion.
source.trial_selection: All and only stim_phase='recog'. Preserve all original learn rows as non_recognition_phase. No correctness/confidence/label/history filter. Only learn/recog source phase tokens are supported.
source.category_source: Original integer stimCategory codes1..5 and nonempty category_name. Require a consistent code/name/path-prefix dictionary within each session, preserving learning and recognition rows. Group by within-session numeric code, never globally by a presumed universal semantic name.
source.category_variant_rule: These exact code-order dictionaries are established by the pre-count original metadata gate; a variant prefix is a released path identity, not a new universal category ontology. Unknown/conflicting mappings fail rather than relabel or drop sessions.
source.clock: All original event/trial/spike seconds retain their arbitrary common nonzero acquisition origin. Event and experiment timestamps are finite, nondecreasing and exactly equal; decode original TTL strings as exact decimal integers. Parse learning/recognition IDs from general/data_collection and cross-check acquisition experiment description. Every trial onset/off/stop must match exactly one same-phase TTL1/2/6 respectively.
source.trial_times: All start/on/off/stop values finite; start==on and on<=off for all rows. Recognition additionally off<=stop. Keep literal learning stop values even when before onset; report full-chain violations, never reassign, shift or exclude the source session.
source.old_new_audit: Preserve source label tokens. Recognition tokens0/1 remain decoded for provenance only, not category selection. Record exact full-path presence in that session's learning rows. Literal description reverses old/new semantics; preserve the text/conflict flag. Incomplete exposure history does not relabel or drop recognition trials.
source.spikes: Validate every unit ragged index and finite stored timestamp. Stable-sort a COPY for search counts while preserving every duplicate occurrence. No deduplication, source rewriting, concatenation repair or raw-unsorted search. Observation coverage is unknown because units/obs_intervals and intervals/invalid_times are absent; do not infer it from spike extrema. Unexpected observation tables fail pending explicit contract review.
source.known_limitations: Pre-count receipts report13 unordered units/7 sessions/20 adjacent inversions/2046 extra exact timestamp occurrences,97 learning-only timing violations in one session,160 old-labelled images missing from released learning in8 sessions, and windows extending beyond stimulus offset. Their physical/export origins are unresolved; all released records and recognition windows remain in scope.

response.equation: start=float64(stim_on_time)+float64(0.2); end=float64(stim_on_time)+float64(1.7); count every stored timestamp s satisfying start<=s<end. Require finite end>start. rate_hz=integer_count/float64(1.5).
response.scope: Every mapped MTL unit x every recognition row. Window is not clipped at stimulus offset, trial end or spike extrema. It can contain post-offset activity; it is not guaranteed pure visual activity.

statistics.rank_input: Exact integer counts. A common positive1.5-second rate denominator preserves order/ties.
statistics.support: Full KW requires all five categories nonempty. Missing category gives insufficient_category_support; keep counts/sums/means/rank sums/tie_sum where computable, but H/p/preference/U/AUC null and selected=false. Small groups remain included; small_group_warning is true iff any present group has fewer than5 rows.
statistics.ranks: Average ranks1..N with pooled count ties; rank_sum_twice_cat_c is the exact integer sum of doubled ranks for category c. tie_sum=sum(t^3-t) for pooled tie multiplicities, exact integer.
statistics.kw: H0=12/[N*(N+1)]*sum((rank_sum_twice_cat_c/2)^2/n_c)-3*(N+1); Ctie=1-tie_sum/(N^3-N); H=H0/Ctie; p=chi2.sf(H,4). No continuity correction. Mathematical H is nonnegative; implementations must not convert unrelated exceptions into p1. Exact-rational H is allowed to avoid cancellation.
statistics.all_tied: When all pooled counts are identical and all groups exist: status=all_tied, H=0,p=1, selected=false, preferred_category=1, preferred_tied=true, AUC=0.5. This explicit convention avoids a library all-identical exception.
statistics.selection: status=ok and unrounded p<0.05; no multiplicity correction in this descriptive method-control threshold. All-tied/unsupported are false.
statistics.preferred: Choose highest category mean count, comparing exact integer sums/denominators; equal means choose smallest numeric code and preferred_tied=true. mean_rate_cat_c=sum_count_cat_c/(1.5*n_cat_c); null only when n_cat_c=0.
statistics.auc: u_preferred_twice=2*sum(count_pref>count_rest)+sum(count_pref==count_rest) over every preferred/rest pair. AUC=u_preferred_twice/(2*n_preferred*n_rest), unflipped. Highest mean need not give AUC>=0.5. Empty positive/rest class is undefined, never fabricated0.5.
statistics.invalid_arithmetic: Fail explicitly on nonfinite/invalid arrays or unexpected numerical errors; do not silently omit a unit or convert an exception to a nonselective result.

splits.schedule: Initialize once. Repeat0..49 outer, then canonical MTL unit order, then numeric category1..5. For each category copy its recognition-position indices in original row order, call rng.shuffle(copy), and take first floor(n_c/2). Union train rows in original row order; test is ordered complement. Never rng.choice, reset seeds, sort unit IDs or share one session mask across units.
splits.support: Require at least2 original recognition rows in every category to produce a split. Otherwise consume no RNG for that unit in any repeat, status=insufficient_category_support, all membership entries false, all train/test support/statistic/preference fields null and both selection flags false. False membership does not imply test for unsupported events.
splits.training: All KW selection, preferred category and preference ties use only training counts. Compute train preferred-vs-rest AUC as a diagnostic. Test AUC uses the training preference without flipping, including for nonselected splits. No test-selected preference or full-data preference substitution.
splits.rows: All50 events per MTL unit are mandatory, including all_tied, unselected and unsupported. status reflects training KW status for supported splits. included_in_conditional_summary==train_selected.
splits.conditional_mean: For each unit, equal-weight mean test_auc over train_selected splits; null if zero. A mean based on1..4 selected splits remains diagnostic but ineligible; >=5 is eligible regardless of full-data selection. All repeated halves are dependent.

aggregation.full_data_selected_same_trials: Equal-unit mean same_trial_auc among full-data category_selective=true units.
aggregation.crossfit_selected_at_least_five_splits: Equal-unit mean conditional_auc among heldout_eligible=true units. Do not pool split rows across units.
aggregation.empty: n_units=0,mean_auc=null,status=empty_population; no failure and no chance substitution.
aggregation.selectivity_fraction: n_category_selective/n_mtl_units using ALL mapped MTL units, not only supported or selected units; null if denominator0. Report supported/unsupported counts separately.
aggregation.overlap: Report full_only,conditional_only,both,neither among all MTL units. No claim these are the same selected population.
aggregation.headline: preferred_category_auc and headline_status exactly select the declared population, which may be either allowed name. Both populations are always reported.

tolerances.exact: Source IDs/categories/labels/counts/sums/rank sums/tie_sum/U2/masks/Boolean flags and source dictionaries exact. Selection/preference/support/eligibility derive from unrounded exact primitives, not rounded submitted floats. Source strings, literal nulls, manifest and method object exact.
tolerances.domains: Counts/sums/H/rates nonnegative; p/AUC/proportions in[0,1]; U2 in[0,2*n_preferred*n_rest]. Only explicitly nullable fields may be null. No NaN/Inf or bool-as-integer.

serialization.csv: Required columns once, UTF-8 comma-separated; coherent key-based row/column reorder and harmless extra columns accepted. Null is empty field. Boolean0/1 or true/false. Exact integral decimal/scientific numeric forms accepted without fractional truncation.
serialization.json: Finite native numbers, true Boolean fields, no duplicate keys. Required keys remain present when null. Named identity/count/population objects closed; harmless descriptive outer keys allowed.
serialization.npz: allow_pickle=False. Unicode unit-key axis, integer non-Boolean axes/counts, floating rates, Boolean membership. Coherent axis/response/repeat permutations accepted. Extra harmless primitive arrays allowed; no object arrays.
serialization.software: Actual nonempty string-to-string software_versions; equivalent implementations need not claim the oracle's libraries.
serialization.evidence: Fresh disjoint output/private directories outside all source and code/contract inputs; no symlink ancestors or overwriting. Failure receipts do not become complete outputs.

sessions.csv.coverage: All87 original assets; pilot explicitly scoped subset only
sessions.csv.types: String identities; literal_session_id nullable string; n_* nonnegative exact integers; status=ok. variant_prefix exact source image prefix, not invented date/session ID.

trials.csv.coverage: Every original trial row including learning
trials.csv.types: source_trial_row nonnegative integer; trial_id integer; category_code integer1..5; exact source strings; finite source times; included Boolean; status included_recognition or non_recognition_phase. source_label integer0/1 and image_in_learning Boolean only for recognition, otherwise both null; literal token always retained.

units.csv.types: Exact identities/integers; source rows nonnegative, n_electrode_links1; included Boolean; region Hippocampus/Amygdala or null exactly if excluded; exclusion_reason included_mtl/non_mtl_location.

responses.npz.rules: Every unit_key once; response_unit_index indexes that supplied axis. Each(unit_key,source_trial_row) exactly once for its session's recognition rows; original trial_id/category agree with trials.csv. All repeats0..49 exactly once. train_membership follows the frozen global RNG and response keys; unsupported allfalse has status semantics above.

neurons.csv.coverage: All MTL units irrespective of selection
neurons.csv.types: Identity strings/integers; n_*,sum_count_*,rank_sum_twice_*,tie_sum exact nonnegative integers; mean_rate nullable only for absent category. full_status ok/all_tied/insufficient_category_support. kw_H/kw_p/preferred_category/preferred_tied/n_preferred/n_rest/u_preferred_twice/same_trial_auc null only for insufficient support; otherwise finite declared domains, preference1..5 and Boolean tie. category_selective/small_group_warning/heldout_eligible Boolean. conditional_status defined/no_selected_splits; conditional_auc null iff selected count0. n_usable_splits0or50; selected<=usable; heldout_eligible iff selected>=5.

split_events.csv.coverage: Every MTL unit x all50 repeats, including unselected/unsupported
split_events.csv.types: repeat exact0..49; status ok/all_tied/insufficient_category_support. Supported rows all fields finite/non-null with support/sums/ranks/tie_sum/U2 exact integers, means/H nonnegative, p/AUC in[0,1], preference1..5, flags Boolean. Unsupported rows every n_train/n_test/train_/test_ field null EXCEPT train_selected=false; included_in_conditional_summary=false. No train membership is generated for unsupported events.

results.json.types: status complete (resource_pilot only for explicit pilot); task_id VISCAT-001; counts nonnegative exact integers; proportion null only denominator0; headline_population allowed name; headline_status defined/empty_population; preferred_category_auc nullable probability selected from that population.

populations.types: n_units nonnegative integer; mean_auc probability or null iff n_units0; status defined/empty_population.

population_overlap.types: Nonnegative exact integers summing to n_mtl_units.

results.json.rules: Both populations always present; counts recompute complete ledgers; n_patients counts distinct literal subject IDs across sessions, not units; n_split_events=50*n_mtl_units. All-tied full tests are defined, not undefined. No aggregate outcome target.

run_metadata.json.types: status complete/resource_pilot; task_id VISCAT-001; dandiset_id000004/published_version0.220126.1852 exactstrings; hashes exact; source_sha256 closed full87-path map; method_contract exact public object; headline same as results; software_versions nonempty string map; warnings array of captured nonempty strings (empty allowed).

nested_objects.clock_mapping_counts: Closed n_trials,onset_exact_unique_ttl1,offset_exact_unique_ttl2,trial_end_exact_unique_ttl6,start_equals_stim_on; nonnegative integers equal trial count when source passes.
nested_objects.label_membership_counts: Closed code0_absent_from_learning,code0_present_in_learning,code1_absent_from_learning,code1_present_in_learning; nonnegative exact original full-path counts.
nested_objects.unit_electrode_link_counts: Closed zero,one,multiple; source mapping requires zero=multiple=0,one=n_source_units.
nested_objects.category_mapping: Order-free five records keyed category_code1..5, each closed {category_code,category_name,variant_prefix,n_recognition}; exact original names/path prefix/support.

source_observed.types: n_* and duplicate/inversion counters nonnegative exact integers; actual identity/date/description strings, nullable literal unit/description attributes, true Boolean presence/clock flags; observation_coverage='unknown'. all_unit_spikes_nondecreasing is measured before copy sorting. duplicate_timestamp_occurrences=sum(len(raw)-len(unique(raw))) per original unit; never a deduplication instruction. Temporal violations count literal full-chain predicate separately per phase.

findings.md.grading: No keywords, fixed phrasing, expected effects, ordering, selected proportion or biological conclusion required.

failure_and_pilot.failure: Exit nonzero; fresh results.json/run_metadata.json status failed_precondition and nonempty reason plus findings.md. If failure occurs after partial publication, retain files and add failure_report.json; verifier rejects failure marker even with any complete marker. Never silently omit source rows or overwrite prior evidence.
failure_and_pilot.pilot: Only explicit --pilot-first-asset: authenticate full87 bytes, compute the first lexical asset only, all its MTL units/recognition trials/all50 repeats. status resource_pilot plus resource_pilot_scope with asset_path and n_processed_assets1; source_sha256 still full87. Tables/counts/source_observed cover processed subset, never represented as complete cohort or usable full reference bank.
failure_and_pilot.reference_performance: Source-only reference can cache deterministic statistics after exact full source primitive/membership identity checks, never from a submitted summary or claimed hash. No reused174 response arrays, old reference bank or oracle outputs as source inputs.
